projects.title: Client Source Reconstruction
projects.summary: Reconstruct the highest-level maintainable client program possible from evidence shipped to, generated in, or observed during an authorized browser session.

status.label: Active
status.detail: Dedicated repository is canonical; acquisition foundation and capture/replay infrastructure are active.

projects.title: Browser Execution Ledger
projects.summary: Privacy-preserving browser execution capture and replay with multi-frame instrumentation, origin virtualization, eager redaction, encrypted ledgers, and differential replay.

status.label: M0 active
status.detail: Canonical ledger and adversarial real-browser capture foundation are under active implementation.

projects.title: Causal Transparency Lab
projects.summary: Executable evidence-first research on objective attribution, causal identification, control attribution, and explicit non-identifiability certificates.

status.label: Active
status.detail: Known-mechanism counterexamples, claim ledger, active-identification protocol, and deterministic results are present.

projects.title: IDC Vision Round-Trip
projects.summary: Recover IDC spatial specifications from images with multimodal models and geometry, then round-trip them against IDC-to-image generation.

status.label: Active
status.detail: Interactive workbench, benchmark/protocol material, structural scoring, and a broad executable test suite are present.

projects.title: IDC Formal Diagram Round-Trip
projects.summary: Test whether an IDC-derived spatial notation can mediate between executable formal semantics, formal diagrams, and multimodal translation while preserving semantic equivalence.

status.label: Active
status.detail: Shared IR, FSM seed tooling, semantic-oracle tests, and the E00-E19 research program are present.

projects.title: IDC Lab
projects.summary: Experimental workbench for IDC as a general spatial and computational primitive: parsing, rendering, rewriting, querying, recursive extensions, and round-tripping.

status.label: Active
status.detail: Experiments 01-09 are represented; the earliest executable browser experiments include parser/rendering, structural grep, and rewrite algebra.

projects.title: Chat Export Kit
projects.summary: Replay and verify provenance-preserving chat-corpus extraction pipelines, semantic projections, review queues, search indexes, and reproducibility checks.

status.label: Active
status.detail: Reference replay, parity reporting, topic retrieval, CI, and mixed Node/Python tests are present.

projects.title: Spread LEQs
projects.summary: Explore a close-to-metal SUBLEQ substrate for generating and optimizing semantically equivalent programs across speed, size, resilience, and residual capacity.

status.label: Active
status.detail: Primitive semantics, executable demos, equivalence families, benchmarks, and Rust tests are present.

projects.title: Searillion
projects.summary: Investigate SEAR over ZDD-backed set families, exploiting compressed symbolic structure while deliberately mapping the frontier where that compression stops paying.

status.label: Early research
status.detail: Graphillion probes, structured-relation experiments, explicit baselines, and tests are present.

projects.title: Alignment Lab
projects.summary: Experimental research on AI alignment as a relational and governance problem: authority, autonomy, reciprocity, objective conflict, supervision, and cooperation.

status.label: Seed
status.detail: Dedicated repository currently contains the project statement but not yet a substantial executable evidence surface.

projects.title: GEAR
projects.summary: Route intent through declarative request and response transformations.

status.label: Migrating
